cover_letter.greeting: Dear Broadridge Corporate Technology Infrastructure Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role supporting Corporate Technology Infrastructure. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it covers the cost side of data centers, hardware and telecom, and infrastructure finance is the area I most want to work in.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation to strengthen financial planning. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment.

That maps to the planning, forecasting, variance work and spend analysis the role describes across OpEx and CapEx. I haven't used TM1 or Anaplan yet, and I'm comfortable in Excel, SAP and Tableau. I'd welcome the chance to talk with the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Financial Analyst role supporting Corporate Technology Infrastructure at Broadridge. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting and variance work. I'd love to hear how the team partners with tech leaders. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
